purpose: Declares the fields the Report Center MUST expose so the operator can verify autonomous progress without typing the next task.

required_fields.description: True when the closed-loop worker pool and at least one of the core timers is active in the last freshness window.
Count of worker leases currently held across closed-loop, Spark, Claude task runner, and Codex worker pools.
Count of distinct worker processes currently executing a leased task.
Tasks in the dispatch queue classified AUTOMATABLE_NOW and not yet leased.
Implementation task completions observed in the last 60 minutes.
Codex review completions (PASS or FAIL) observed in the last 60 minutes.
Production-equivalence blockers transitioned from open to resolved/deferred since policy install.
Count of OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED items in the classified next-action set.
Count of EXTERNAL_SOURCE_REQUIRED items in the classified next-action set.
Count of EVENT_DEPENDENT items in the classified next-action set.
Count of POSITION_DEPENDENT items in the classified next-action set.
Count of UNSAFE_TO_AUTOMATE items (Redis trim, exchange mutation, live enable, etc.).
The exact next AUTOMATABLE_NOW action the worker pool will pick up. Set to null only when no automatable task exists.
The exact next OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED action awaiting operator signature.
If queue is empty AND autoseed was unable to add a safe task, the exact reason all remaining blockers are operator/event/external/position dependent.
True iff every Codex FAIL has been mapped to a remediation task or classified OPERATOR_REQUIRED / UNSAFE_TO_AUTOMATE.
